call_points.text: Strategic investment brands guided to ₹750-800 Cr revenue for FY27, against ₹160 Cr in Q1.
Input cost up 360 bps: 200 bps from West Asia conflict, 160 bps from mix; pricing expected to offset the absolute increase.
Domestic business grew 20%, or 12% like-to-like with 8% volume growth after adjusting Axiom and IncNut base.
Core domestic business excluding acquisitions grew about 6%.
International business fell 12% as West Asia conflict blocked OTC pain management shipments from India.
International business expected to show significant growth in Q3 and Q4 after strategy realignment.
Effective tax rate guided to 25-26% this year as prior fiscal benefits lapse.
Start-up portfolio is at about EBITDA breakeven, with a high-single-digit margin targeted in three years.
Talcum powder expected to recover to FY25 levels with substantially higher numbers this year.
Analyst pressed on margin range before other income; management gave no band, citing the West Asia conflict as short term.
Gross margins expanded by 250 bps YoY to 68.4% in Q4 driven by cost discipline and pricing actions.

guidance.statement: Strategic investment portfolio revenue to reach ₹750-800 Cr for FY27
Effective tax rate to normalise to 25-26%
Pricing actions expected to more than offset the absolute increase in input cost during the financial year
Strategic investments to reach high single-digit EBITDA margin in about three years

industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Personal Products > Personal Care

operating_notes.text: Issued corporate guarantees totaling ₹176.24 Cr to HDFC Bank Ambala on behalf of subsidiaries AAPL (₹7.10 Cr), AFBPL (₹151.52 Cr), and APPL (₹17.62 Cr).
Approved acquisition of 60% stake in IncNut Digital for up to ₹321 Cr; IncNut turnover was ₹175.1 Cr (FY25), ₹196.5 Cr (FY24), ₹231.9 Cr (FY23).
Re-appointed Harsha Vardhan Agarwal as Vice-Chairman & Managing Director for 5 years.
Consciously reduced receivables by over ₹100 crores during the year, improving working capital cycle by 10 days.
Completed acquisition of 59.69% stake in IncNut Digital Private Limited.
Strategic investment brands did ₹160 Cr in Q1FY27, 18% of domestic business, at about EBITDA breakeven with gross margins above 55%.
Organised channels are 32% of domestic business and quick commerce is 35% of e-com; international business fell 12% on West Asia conflict disruption.
Input cost rose 360 bps in Q1FY27, of which about 200 bps was the West Asia conflict and 160 bps business mix.

timeline.summary: Emami approved SSPA to acquire 60% stake in IncNut Digital for up to ₹321 Cr, with full buyout planned over 4.5 years.
Suraj Finvest Private Limited, via Santinath Paul, disclosed no new share encumbrances by Emami Limited promoters for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on 01.04.2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹925.1 Cr (-3.9% YoY), net profit ₹143.17 Cr (-11.7% YoY).
Emami Limited shared the audio recording link for its Q4 FY-26 conference call with analysts/investors on 21st May 2026 via Ravi Varma.
On May 21, 2026, Emami Limited hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, reporting a 4% revenue decline to ₹925 Cr due to a weak summer portfolio.
On June 1, 2026, Emami completed the acquisition of a 59.69% stake in IncNut Digital Private Limited, making it a subsidiary.
On 4 August 2026 Emami's Q1FY27 call reported 15% revenue growth to ₹1,039 Cr, with input costs up 360 bps and PAT down 16% on tax normalisation.
Emami scheduled board meeting on 5 Nov 2026 to consider interim dividend for FY27
